R14.falsifier: a row scored from an advertised limit, an unmeasured envelope or a fleet probability

R17.falsifier: a store-dependent row scored without the #123 condition

assumptions.store-qualification: Conditional: #123 records no ST1 to ST8 qualification
assumptions.store-outage: an unavailable store answers no takeover compare-and-swap and no coverage fence, so no takeover proceeds while it lasts; the store steps are sized for an available store
assumptions.store-restore: after an operator store restore the fleet stays closed until #123 establishes namespace safety and complete acknowledged coverage; no owner input reopens it
assumptions.host-loss-keeps-volume: host loss keeps the volume at its identity and generation and S at its certified cut; the successor loads warm and no row models a whole-cache refill
assumptions.actual-volume-loss: only an actual volume loss provisions a replacement volume, which starts cold; correlated impairment holds for diagnosis and never provisions
assumptions.store-throttle: the store makes one attempt per request and reads a throttled request as an unknown outcome that ends the takeover attempt, so the store steps hold only while the scenario's store load row fits
assumptions.designated-host-detection: after the designated host's controller is ready its detector nominates the silent owner; the standby's measured fault-to-nomination detection sizes that nomination
assumptions.cold-refill-concurrency: cold_refill is the refill the campaign measured at its own count of concurrent volume losses against its own origin; concurrent_volume_losses sizes the store and provider rows, and the refill time holds up to the campaign's count
assumptions.l-data-ratio: the read step's ratio is the campaign's measured recovery time over L_data, the time the C2 rates give for the recovery's work; it scales every row of the step, the owner-rate rows included, as the campaign's own throttles shaped that time

recovery_ops.draft: The recovery record a credited receipt binds counts the device operations the warm load issues.

index_bytes.draft: The warm activation reports the index bytes it builds in RAM.

volume_create_latency.draft: The reconciler's actual-volume-loss path records the loss judgment, the create request and the replacement volume's attach.

fresh_host_designation.draft: The reconciler's fresh-host path records the joint loss of owner and standby and its attach request of the designated host.

recovery_ram.draft: The warm activation reports its peak helper, allocator and buffer bytes above the index it builds.

shard_ram.draft: The warm activation reports a served shard's steady bytes beside its index.

designation_store_requests.draft: The store clients of the reconciler and of the designated host count every request of one fresh-host designation: the census reservation, the attach event, the pair's enrollment and the designation.

replacement_store_requests.draft: The store clients of the reconciler and of the replacement's owner count every request of one replacement: the receipt, volume-record, attach-event, spare and flip writes and the owner's enrollment, bump, Confirm and coverage fences.

runtime_ram.draft: The qualification host report records the RAM in use before the host's first attach.

detection.meaning: the standby's detection from the fault to its nomination

store_steps.meaning: the takeover compare-and-swap and the coverage fences, measured at the campaign's concurrency

store_load.meaning: the requests of the AZ's concurrent takeovers, each issuing the recovery stratum's measured requests of one takeover (its compare-and-swap, coverage adds and fences and attempt-counter bump), all within one burst window, against the requests the store admits in that window after the region's steady publication, coverage and retry traffic; past 1 the store throttles takeovers

fresh_host_store_load.meaning: the requests of the AZ's concurrent fresh-host recoveries, each issuing the requests of one fresh-host designation and then the recovery stratum's measured requests of one takeover, all within one burst window, against the requests the store admits in that window; past 1 the store throttles recoveries

fresh_host_designation.meaning: the reconciler's interval from the joint loss of owner and standby to its attach request of the designated host, which reserves the lost standby's census slot and writes the designation

fresh_host_attachment.meaning: the reconciler's attach of a designated fresh host to the surviving volume until its controller is ready

volume_read.meaning: the shared volume reads one checkpoint slot at E_max extent rows and at most the delta region's suffix blocks at its calibrated floor

volume_ops.meaning: the shared volume serves the warm load's operations at its calibrated floor

share_read.value: (shards_per_host + concurrent_recoveries_per_host) * (1 + ceil(e_max / unit_entries) + delta_blocks) * io_unit / recovery_share_rate
share_read.meaning: each recovering owner reads its slot and suffix blocks within its part of the host's recovery I/O share: the share's bytes per second over every owner the successor runs, its owned shards and its concurrent recoveries

host_read.value: concurrent_recoveries_per_host * (1 + ceil(e_max / unit_entries) + delta_blocks) * io_unit / (host_bandwidth * (1 - foreground_link_share) - 2 * shards_per_host * mutation_rate * checkpoint_units * io_unit)
host_read.meaning: the successor's EBS link reads one slot and the suffix blocks per concurrent recovery from the calibrated floor left after the foreground's byte share and its owned shards' publication traffic, a write and a read-back per published unit

host_ops.value: concurrent_recoveries_per_host * recovery_ops / (host_iops * (1 - foreground_iops_share) - 2 * shards_per_host * mutation_rate * checkpoint_units)
host_ops.meaning: the successor's EBS operations per concurrent recovery from the calibrated floor left after the foreground's operation share and a write and a read-back per published unit

index_build.meaning: the successor builds each concurrent recovery's index in RAM at the calibrated rate

worker_cpu.meaning: the successor's recovery workers spend each concurrent activation's measured CPU

attempt_cpu.meaning: one activation's measured CPU spread over the helper threads its attempt runs

volume_create.meaning: from the actual volume loss to the replacement volume's attach: the reconciler's loss judgment, the provider's create and the attach

cold_refill.meaning: origin refill of the replacement volume until the pre-fault hit share returns

host_attachments.meaning: a host attaches the volumes it owns and those it is the named standby of on the same volume, plus transient replacement-standby attaches of planned handoffs and fresh-host enrollments, against the attachments the instance type leaves to cache volumes after its boot volume and every other attachment it counts

replacement_attachments.meaning: a host attaches the volumes it owns and stands by, the transient replacement-standby attaches of planned handoffs and fresh-host enrollments that a volume loss can overlap, and the replacement volumes it takes, each attached before its lost volume detaches, against the attachments the instance type leaves to cache volumes

volume_attachments.meaning: a volume holds at most MAX_ATTACHED live attaches at one time: the owner's, the named standby's and a replacement standby's or fresh host's; an ended attach leaves the live count at its end write

host_ram.meaning: the successor's runtime, each owned shard's and each concurrent recovery's index and steady shard bytes, and each recovery's helper, allocator and buffer bytes, against the host's RAM

campaign_ram.meaning: the campaign host's measured peak RAM at N_max objects, with the campaign's own shards and recoveries, against the host's RAM

protected_history.value: (1 + checkpoint_slots * (1 + ceil(e_max / unit_entries)) + delta_blocks) * io_unit / volume_size_bytes
protected_history.meaning: the volume prefix reserves the activation unit, K checkpoint slots at E_max extent rows and the delta region for protected history, against the whole volume; fits covers the metadata reservation alone

extent_rows.meaning: the N_max objects' extent rows against the E_max extent rows a slot holds

standby_census.meaning: the AZ's shards against its standby cap; past 1, a shard beyond the cap holds no census slot, and while the census is full its owner loss has neither a standby nor a fresh-host designation, which also takes a census slot

census_encoding.meaning: the standby cap against the entries one census record encodes

replacement_store_load.meaning: the requests of the concurrent replacements, each issuing every request the reconciler and the replacement's owner make for one replacement, all taken within one burst window as an upper bound, against the requests the store admits in that window; past 1 the store throttles replacements

replacement_history.value: (1 + checkpoint_slots * (1 + ceil(e_max / unit_entries)) + delta_blocks) * io_unit / volume_size_bytes
replacement_history.meaning: the replacement volume's prefix reserves the same activation unit, K checkpoint slots at E_max extent rows and delta region as the lost volume's layout, against the whole volume

replacement_extent_rows.meaning: the extent rows of the N_max objects the refill restores against the E_max extent rows a slot of the replacement holds

volume_create_quota.meaning: replacement volumes created at once against the CreateVolume requests the provider's request bucket admits in one burst

volume_bytes_quota.meaning: replacement volume bytes provisioned at once against the provisioned-bytes quota the standing fleet and the lost volumes not yet deleted leave unused in the replacement's account, Region and volume type

volume_iops_quota.meaning: replacement volumes' provisioned IOPS at once against the provisioned-IOPS quota the standing fleet and the lost volumes not yet deleted leave unused in the replacement's account, Region and volume type

standby-takeover.trigger: host loss of the owner: the named standby, attached to the same volume, takes it over at its generation

fresh-host-recovery.trigger: loss of the owner and its standby: the reconciler designates a fresh host in the lost standby's census slot and attaches it to the surviving volume, which loads warm

actual-volume-loss.trigger: actual volume loss: a replacement volume is created on demand and starts cold
